pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly polygonal dark regions with relatively sharp edge gradients against the lighter corridors. Patches on the mid-flank exhibit high spatial area and predominantly four-to-five-sided geometric profiles.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of cream-colored light pathways forming a topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily trivalent. Path thickness is relatively consistent across the mid-flank with slight narrowing at vertex intersections.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark-colored avian organism is visible clinging to the pelage at the upper junction of the neck and shoulder.
